description: This file defines data models related to usage costs, including structures for totals, daily data, and summaries, as well as utility functions for formatting and a loader for retrieving the summary asynchronously.

methods.name: formatUsd
methods.description: Formats a Double value as a USD string with appropriate decimal places based on the value.

methods.name: formatTokenCount
methods.description: Formats an integer token count into a human-readable string with units like 'k' or 'm'.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the usage cost summary by requesting data through the ControlChannel.
